result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.trav_out_edge()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Traverse from selected nodes to outbound edges. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6452-L6490){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.trav_out_edge() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} From the currently selected nodes, moves to all edges where the selected nodes are sources (outbound edges). The current node selection is cleared and replaced with an edge selection. For directed graphs, selects edges where from=selected_node. For undirected graphs, selects all edges incident to selected nodes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Traversing from "A" to its outbound edges replaces the node selection with an edge selection -- here, both edges leaving "A": ::: {#c3eaf651 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_node(label="A") graph.add_node(label="B") graph.add_node(label="C") graph.add_edge(source="A", target="B") graph.add_edge(source="A", target="C") node_a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") graph.select_nodes_by_id([node_a_id]).trav_out_edge() len(graph.get_selected_edge_ids()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
